name: sky-boss
description: Lint and unit-test config for the canvas and the Electron shell. The project is Python; this exists so the JavaScript is checked and its pure logic is tested.

scripts.//lint:check: The --max-warnings number is a RATCHET. It may only go down. Never raise it to make a commit pass — fix the warning, or suppress it inline with a written reason.
scripts.//test: node --test, built into node 22 — no dependency. It covers the PURE half only; it cannot see an unpainted mark, an htm comment eating an element's children, or a dialog off the edge at scale 2.4. The headless pass in CLAUDE.md is not retired by this.
